content: Electron bundles Chromium+Node (main/renderer split via IPC), heavier (80-150MB, 150-300MB RAM) but mature ecosystem for native modules like node-pty; Tauri uses Rust core + OS WebView, much lighter (under 10MB, 30-50MB RAM), PTY handled in Rust backend, stricter permission model via IPC commands. For an Electron/Tauri decision involving heavy native-module use (node-pty) and mature JS terminal/file-watching ecosystem, Electron's Node.js main process is the path of least resistance.
